nom: Peter Thomas Roth Instant FIRMx Eye Temporary Eye Tightener Easy-Wear Formula

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as having sensitive skin more often report burning, redness, or swelling after application, and one such reviewer links negative reactions generally to sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s or with aging, crepey, or hollow under-eyes report visible tightening and reduction of puffiness and wrinkles, though one mature-skin reviewer reports the area became saggier and crepier after use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report a reduction in fine lines, crow's feet, and forehead wrinkles within minutes of application; one reviewer reports the opposite, saying the skin looked saggier and more crepey a week after use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the under-eye area feels or looks dried out, tight, or flaky after application, with two describing worsened dryness or crepiness over repeated use; others report no dryness issue at all.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers report a burning sensation, a bright red mark, or swollen eyes after use, though this is not common across the reviews.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports a burn mark and eye swelling after a third use of the product, suggesting a possible irritation or barrier reaction, but no other reviewer corroborates this severity.
concerns.spots: Not discussed by reviewers in relation to this eye product.
concerns.blemishes: Not discussed by reviewers in relation to this eye product.
concerns.oiliness: Not discussed by reviewers in relation to this eye product.

aspects.libelle: White residue or film on skin
New formula improved over original, less residue

extraits.texte: This stuff works. You will erase years of wrinkles for a day. It has high potential for climbing, as in little white dots where there is too much product. So there is a learning curve. But I looked amazing! The real problem is the next day or week. I'm 7 days from using it. It's as if it sucked all moisture from under my eyes and I can't get it back I now look older than ever. I've been moisturizing like crazy day and night. It's super saggy and crepey and delicate skin now. I really regret using it.

I want to start off by saying I did not purchase this product from Ulta. My husband got it for me as a gift and honestly I do not know where he ordered it from all I can say is it was the name brand product I used it twice and was fine the third time I used it it left a bright red mark under my eye it burnt when I applied it and left a white residue so I ended up wiping it off the next day I woke up with a burn mark and my eyes swelled up

extraits.titre: Why didn't anyone tell me about this product sooner??
extraits.texte: I am in my 40's and definitely noticing the skin around my eyes aging and looking puffy in the morning. After applying this product I notice a huge difference in minutes! It smoothes out puffiness and takes years off my aging eyes! My only complaint is that it does not mix well with liquid makeup so I had to start using a powder foundation, but I'll take it to look a few years younger!

extraits.titre: Not good for true eye bags
extraits.texte: I dont any wrinkles just a eye bag with a true fat pad and it didnt do much of anything for that it did tighten some of the creases i have under my eyes but thats about it. Dries your undereyes out bad. And peels. Ive tried to wear it under makeup and it peels everytime no matter what i try but i also use alot of concealer and foundation so maybe if you just used a BB cream you could pull it off.

This had real results. Took me completely by surprise to actually watch in the mirror the bags under my eyes vanish within minutes. There is a "tight" feeling that may occur but will pass. I've read several of the negative reviews and I believe some (not alll) stem from not following the instructions or having sensitive skin. Just my own thoughts.

extraits.titre: New formula is for superior to original!
extraits.texte: This new easy to wear formula is far superior than the original! I've been using the original for over a year, and I used to mix it with the primer to try to help the white residue issue, but every day was still a struggle. I've been amazed at how easy it has been to apply this new improved easy to wear formula. I have not had any white residue and I don't need to wipe it off and put it back on several times as I did with the original. I highly recommend it. I have loss of elasticity under my eyes with a little puffiness and it tightens it right up!

extraits.titre: I will definitely buy again & again!
extraits.texte: This new version of this product is so much better than the original product. It goes on easy, doesn't get white specks or a thin white coating, and lasts until I wash it off in the evening.
